title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
task: KV cache compression for long-context multimodal inference
key_results: Global KV cache footprint reduced to 890 bytes/token (1/4 of baseline); persistent KV cache footprint reduced to 1/8 of DeepSeek-V4-Flash; supports 1M token contexts with 552B MoE backbone
comments: Combines multiple compression techniques (CSA2, FP4 quantization, SWA Bounded Replay) to achieve substantial improvements; primarily an engineering contribution rather than novel algorithmic insights.

hypotheses.hypothesis: KV cache compression via cross-layer reuse and quantization enables efficient long-context inference
hypotheses.result: Achieved 4x reduction in global KV cache footprint while improving downstream performance

title: SoL-Pi: Recursively Scaling Auto-Research Loops for Efficient Agent Harness
task: Token-efficient scaling of auto-research loops for coding agents
key_results: 44.7-49.0% reduction in token traffic; ~33% reduction in API cost; estimated hourly savings of $8.75-13.50 vs. native baselines
comments: Focuses on practical deployment efficiency rather than accuracy gains; mechanisms are relatively incremental improvements in existing harness design.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scaling auto-research loops across diverse environments yields transferable improvements
hypotheses.result: Four mechanisms survive selection and transfer beyond development setting with 44-49% token reduction

title: When EOS Tokens Disagree: Understanding Length Inflation in On-Policy Distillation
task: Understanding and mitigating length inflation in on-policy distillation
key_results: Identified termination-token mismatch as key source of length inflation; treating functionally equivalent EOS tokens as shared semantic actions substantially mitigates inflation across Qwen, Llama, Gemma
comments: Thorough empirical analysis of a subtle but important phenomenon; proposes simple fix that generalizes across model families.

hypotheses.hypothesis: EOS token mismatch between base students and post-trained teachers causes length inflation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; aligning EOS tokens as shared semantic actions mitigates inflation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Termination alignment is sufficient to prevent length inflation
hypotheses.result: Partially false; alignment helps but late-stage inflation persists from other causes

title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
task: Component-level evaluation of coding agent harness design
key_results: 176 matched settings evaluated; context management most valuable under tight budgets (prevents overflow failures); rule-based elision + LLM summarization optimal; bash-capable models achieve lower cost with bash-only interface
comments: Systematic ablation study providing actionable insights for harness design; trajectory-level analysis explains mechanistic effects rather than just accuracy metrics.

model_io.model: Four models (GPT-4o, Claude, DeepSeek, Qwen variants)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Context management effectiveness depends on budget constraints
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; most benefit from preventing overflow failures

hypotheses.hypothesis: Planning uniformly improves accuracy
hypotheses.result: False; shifts from accuracy scaffold for weak models to cost saver for strong models

title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
task: Domain-agnostic world modeling via orthogonal predictive factorization
key_results: JEPA-Anything improves on all 10 matched dynamics tasks vs. JEPA; 34.8% error reduction on Interventional Pong; 100-step molecular rollouts with lowest errors across 4 systems; factor-nominated intervention receives experimental validation
comments: Impressive breadth across seven domains with both computational and experimental validation; OPF principle is well-motivated but conceptual novelty is moderate.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orthogonal factorization of latent targets enables transfer across heterogeneous domains
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across vision, biology, clinical, control, molecular, fields, weather

hypotheses.hypothesis: Factorized representations support intervention discovery
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with experimental validation in biological systems

title: RiskChainBench: A Benchmark for Obfuscated Platform Message Restoration and Evidence-Grounded Web Investigation
task: Evaluating obfuscated message restoration and risk investigation in abuse campaigns
key_results: Entry Top-1 ranges 35.2-95.2% across 10 models; web decision accuracy 26.3-62.8%; execution failures account for 31.9% of failures vs. 0.9% type errors
comments: Addresses realistic platform-abuse detection combining NLP and web-navigation reasoning; benchmark is comprehensive but synthetic environment may not fully capture real-world complexity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Entry recovery and web investigation can be decomposed and measured separately
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; composition reveals different bottlenecks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Execution failures dominate error distribution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 31.9% execution vs. 0.9% type errors

title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
task: Self-retiring on-policy distillation for multi-turn agentic RL
key_results: ALFWorld: 14.1-18.8% success rate improvement over RL baseline; WebShop: 11.8-19.0% accuracy improvement; student surpasses teacher in all settings
comments: Adaptive retirement mechanism is intuitive and well-motivated; key insight that teacher supervision is stage-dependent addresses real training dynamics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fixed distillation schedules are suboptimal for agentic tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; adaptive retirement based on discrepancy and success-rate matching works better

hypotheses.hypothesis: Skill-conditioned teachers are inherently reliable supervisors
hypotheses.result: False; teacher supervision benefit is stage-dependent and requires adaptive dropout

title: WeVisDoc: From Coverage to Capability for Robust End-to-End Document Parsing
task: Robust end-to-end document parsing via data-centric learning
key_results: OmniDocBench v1.6: 95.38 overall score for 4B model; PureDocBench: 75.54 mean score; Stage II improves 2B and 4B models with 4.03-point gain on Real Degraded track
comments: Two-stage data-centric approach (coverage broadening + targeted diagnostic) shows clear benefits; methodology is systematic but primarily engineering-driven.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Expanding coverage alone is insufficient for robust parsing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Visual-structural clustering reveals residual errors amenable to targeted data construction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with larger gains on degraded tracks

title: Reflect, Revise, Reuse: Training-Free Skill Evolution for GUI Agents
task: Training-free skill evolution for GUI agents via reflect-revise-reuse loops
key_results: MobileWorld: +16.2% improvement; AndroidWorld: +6.0%; OSWorld: +10.5%; evolved skills transfer to related tasks without retraining
comments: Clever training-free approach leveraging execution feedback; limitation is that gains are moderate and depend heavily on execution success.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Skills can improve through deployment-time feedback without additional training

hypotheses.hypothesis: Evolved skills transfer to related tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; skill libraries continue to benefit beyond development setting

task: Evaluating embodied spatial intelligence through active perception and metric control
key_results: Best model: 100% target localization, 78.9% spatial relations, but only 53.93±3.17% task success; active camera control: 27.86%→57.50% success; held-out geometry reduces success by 30+ points; no model completes long-horizon episode
comments: Comprehensive benchmark exposing significant gaps in MLLM spatial reasoning; multiple evaluation perspectives (terminal success, trajectory diagnostics, transfer) provide nuanced picture.

hypotheses.hypothesis: MLLMs can learn spatial reasoning from RGB demonstrations alone

hypotheses.hypothesis: Active perception substantially improves task success
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 2.06x improvement over passive observation

title: Video DeltaNet: A Video-Native Hybrid Attention for Livestream Video Generation
task: Hybrid local Softmax + linear attention for efficient video generation
key_results: 14.5x speedup for 14.3-second 768p video (8 B200 GPUs); 6.70 seconds vs. 50-step baseline; 8-step distillation enables deployment efficiency
comments: Practical efficiency contribution combining local and linear attention; architectural novelty is moderate but engineering execution is solid.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid attention (local Softmax + linear memory) preserves fine-grained interactions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via Video Delta Attention mechanism

title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
task: Feed-forward 3D articulation modeling from sparse point clouds
key_results: Consistent improvements over feed-forward and optimization baselines on PartNet-Mobility, ACD, ArtiCraft-10K; Multi-state Articulation Transformer with alternating attention outperforms baselines

task: Evaluating omni-condition alignment in multi-modal image generation
key_results: UFO achieves highest correlation with human judgment (+15.25% average improvement); UFO-Bench evaluates subject-driven customization under diverse text-visual interactions

task: Evaluating physical world reasoning in omni-modal generative models
key_results: MiniMax-H3 overall success: 41.97%; Video Decision Reasoning: 56.00%; Audio Disambiguation: 27.40%; multimodal integration remains bottleneck
comments: Well-designed evaluation framework testing true multimodal reasoning rather than isolated modalities; results highlight challenges in effective multimodal fusion.

title: When2Think: Learning Difficulty-Aware Length Control for Efficient Hybrid Reasoning Models
task: Difficulty-aware computation allocation for hybrid reasoning models
key_results: AIME24: Pass@3 +10.0%, token usage -27.9%; AIME25: 40.0% Pass@3; When2Think outperforms compression and routing baselines on efficiency-accuracy trade-off
comments: Instance-adaptive allocation via reward shaping is elegant; IDAC mechanism avoids learned reward models, improving stability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Uniform length penalties are suboptimal for mixed-difficulty problems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; difficulty-aware allocation improves accuracy-efficiency trade-off

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pre-computed reference statistics enable stable learning without online queries
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via IDAC mechanism

title: What Does Privileged Information Add to On-Policy Self-Distillation?
task: Quantifying privileged information value in on-policy self-distillation
key_results: Reference-free distillation accounts for much of improvement; privileged reference benefit modest in Qwen (strongest for polished solution), +2pp in SmolLM3 for complete traces; cross-mode transfer dominates over reference-specific gains
comments: Carefully constructed AMPLE-Math benchmark enables controlled comparison; finding that reference value is orthogonal to supervision type is counterintuitive and important.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Privileged information substantially improves OPSD beyond distillation itself
hypotheses.result: False; cross-mode transfer dominates, reference benefit is modest

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complete solution traces add more value than direct answers
hypotheses.result: Partially true; +2pp in SmolLM but orthogonal training dynamics negate benefits

title: Region-Level Policy Optimization for Fine-grained MLLM Perception
task: Region-level RL for efficient fine-grained MLLM perception
key_results: Improves accuracy across 6 benchmarks at every token budget; surpasses largest-budget accuracy with ~4x fewer visual tokens; proposal network refined via RL without region annotations
comments: Novel Vision-RL2 mechanism (region as action, frozen reader as reward) elegantly avoids annotation burden; demonstrates clear efficiency-accuracy trade-off improvement.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Localization tolerates 3-4x higher token compression than recognition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via diagnostic; motivates coarse localization + fine recognition

hypotheses.hypothesis: Region-level RL improves proposal quality without region supervision
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; subtractive/additive objectives enable learning from MLLM reader feedback

title: PACT: Can Enterprise AI Assistants Be Trusted Under Pressure?
task: Evaluating compliance rule-following in enterprise AI agents under pressure
key_results: Substantial variability across 22 models; even strongest assistants mis-apply rules on 6-10% of items; user pressure raises violation rate by 65% average; organized across 48 scenarios in 12 regulated domains
comments: Addresses critical real-world concern (compliance in sensitive contexts); PACT framework is comprehensive with LLM-as-judge auditing; results highlight serious deployment risks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Enterprise LLMs consistently follow compliance rules under pressure

hypotheses.hypothesis: Larger models are uniformly more compliant
hypotheses.result: False; compliance depends on multiple orthogonal dimensions and model families

task: Telugu spoken question answering evaluation with validation of evaluation methods
key_results: VākQA: 2,001 QA pairs, 2.53 hours speech, 6 domains; Gemini-as-judge best approximates human but non-uniformly strict; open-weight judges penalize valid Telugu surface-form variations
comments: Addresses underexplored low-resource language setting; validates that standard automatic evaluation fails for Telugu; cascaded ASR-MT errors compound problem.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Automatic evaluation methods correlate with human judgment for Telugu SQA
hypotheses.result: Partially false; Gemini better than open-weight but non-uniformly strict

title: Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL
task: Learning environment dynamics via observation supervision in action prediction
key_results: ActObs achieves higher pass@k at every budget than action-only on Terminal-Bench 2.0; +3.4pp at pass@16 on Qwen3-8B; +4.2pp on cross-domain code editing; preserves more entropy during RL
comments: Simple but effective insight: supervising observations improves policy modeling of action consequences; mechanism is orthogonal to action gradients, preventing one-sided specialization.

outputs: policies with action and observation predictions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Observation supervision improves downstream RL performance despite unused outputs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Action and observation gradients remain aligned during SFT

title: Srijika: OpenType-Layout-Reusing Font Restyling for Nine Indic Scripts

outputs: restyled TTF fonts preserving glyph shaping

hypotheses.result: Partially false; template copying more reliable; diffusion conditioning limits unclear

title: Green fluorescent protein and its fusion constructs induce intracellular puncta under defined conditions
task: Distinguish genuine biomolecular condensate formation from fluorescent protein artifacts in living cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: FUS forms condensates under standard (serum-containing) conditions
hypotheses.result: FUS–EGFP puncta observed in serum-containing medium with distinct physicochemical properties from αS–EGFP and tau–EGFP

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fluorescent protein identity does not affect condensate detection

title: TWF1 inhibition overcomes cisplatin resistance in NSCLC by inducing ferroptosis via p53-dependent SLC7A11 repression and autophagy-mediated glutathione metabolism reprogramming

hypotheses.hypothesis: TWF1 induces autophagy-mediated metabolic reprogramming to sustain system Xc⁻ activity

title: Annexin A6 modulates apoptotic priming and BCL-2 dependency in acute lymphoblastic leukaemia

title: Central spindle instability and ectopic furrow organization mark fragmentation-prone first mitosis in human embryos
